title: Graef's AutoCare | Mobile Car Detailing
text: I value my customers health and well-being & prioritizes building a connection with you guys!
The product I use are tried and true and trusted amongst all detailers worldwide
Professional detailing packages, ready to book online. (Some Higher Level Services may require Deposits and Quotes)
Perfect for you if your vehicle has been neglected after a while. Provides full steam cleaning and disinfecting all plastics with a Chlorine Dioxide which kills oder causing bacteria
Provides a full fledged steam cleaning and stain removal on fabrics and upholstery. Also treated with a Chlorine Dioxide treatments to remediate as much oder as possible.
Provides a deep enhanced gloss by decontaminating the vehicles paint and applying a sealant to the paint

Provides a deep enchased gloss by giving your vehicle a wax machine polish dedicated to improving your vehicles gloss and removing very minor scratches and swirl marks. (NOTICE: this service is not dedicated to removing paint defects only meant to enhance the vehicles overall gloss and add protection)

This package bridges the gap between a paint enhancement and a single stage paint correction. It includes a carnuaba based wax and compound designed to cut away 40%-70% of scratches while leaving a nice waxed finish!
Provides a single stage machine polish to reduce scratches and enhance the gloss to customers desire
Provides a 1 Stage cutting step designed to remove as much defects as possible then followed up with a second stage to polish and add to gloss and depth
Recurring care plans you can join online.

Trusted by car owners in your area.
"We only trust Graef AutoCare to keep our Mazda always looking stellar!! Austin is always prompt and very hard-working. Thank you Austin!"

I'm a 20 year old college student. I started with my passion from detailing from realizing how therapeutic cleaning cars is for me. It started about 2-3 years ago when I decided to take my first steps towards creating my detailing business. It didn't last very long because I didn't really have proper knowledge and experience on how to develop and build as a business. 8 months ago I've landed on Graef AutoCare! where I have took initiative and proper drive on detailing professional here in the Bakersfield Area! I've met so many new people and faces, I love and take pride in my customer experience and relations. Thank You So Much for your time and consideration! - Austin Graef, Your Detailer
